tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250rdo rje tshe'i skaur las/ tshe sgrub kyi byin 'beb bzhugs so// 1$0000300hrī: sngon gyi bskal pa'i dang po la: bde ba can gyi zhing khams su: mgon po tshe dpag med pa dang: yum chen na bza' dkar mo yis: skye 'chi med pa'i tshe dbang thob: bsgres rgud med pa'i sku mchog brnyes: khyed kyis tshe dbang byin chen phob: ri bo ta la'i pho brang na: 'phags pa thugs rje chen po dang: yum chen gsang ba ye shes kyis: skye 'chi med pa'i tshe dbang thob: bsgres rgud med pa'i sku mchog brnyes: khyed kyis tshe dbang byin chen phob: brag phug mā ra tī ka ru: slob dpon padma 'byung gnas dang: lha lcam mandā ra ba yis: skye 'chi med pa'i tshe dbang thob: bsgres rgud med pa'i sku mchog brnyes: khyed kyis tshe dbang byin chen phob: g.ya' ma lung gi dben gnas su: 'chi med padma 'byung gnas dang: bde chen rgya mtsho gnyis med kyis: skye 'chi med pa'i tshe dbang thob: bsgres rgud med pa'i sku mchog brnyes: khyed kyis tshe dbang byin chen phob: stag tshang seng ge bsam 'grub tu: skad gnyis smra ba'i rig ldan dang: bde ba'i dpal mo gnyis med kyis: skye 'chi med pa'i tshe dbang thob: bsgres rgud med pa'i sku mchog brnyes: khyed kyis tshe dbang byin chen phob: sngon tshe tshe yi khungs re bzang: da ni tshe yi dpal re 'dus: byin chen rnams kyis byin phob la: dbang chen rnams kyis dbang skur cig: badzra ghu ru padma siddhi siddhi puṇye dzñā na ā yuḥsiddhi hūm̐ dza dza:
